programme.desc: S4 E3 — The Hardest Word The Ghosts try to get back into Alison's good books after she gives them the biggest telling off of their lives/deaths. Alison and Mike learn that relaxation is harder than it looks.
programme.title: Ghosts

programme.desc: S4 E4 — Gone Gone Shocking news rocks Button House and a booking mix-up sees Mike and Alison forced to host a last-minute children's party that they are utterly unprepared for.
programme.title: Ghosts

programme.desc: S4 E5 — Poached Guests Alison and Mike's neighbour spots a business opportunity which sparks all out war between them. The Captain makes a discovery and the Ghosts find a surprising new friend.
programme.title: Ghosts

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Episode 6 As the Reading Festival commences, no one can tell what is in store. The junior doctors must be prepared for everything from a drug overdose to a mosh pit injury.
programme.title: Emergency: First Time Medics

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Episode 7 Christine handles a mysterious fall case, Adrian learns how to set a broken ankle, Alex helps a child who has been hit by a car, and Claire deals with a woman with agonising chest pain.
programme.title: Emergency: First Time Medics

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Once More With Feeling Susan wants to renew her wedding vows with Ben, which is no problem for him, until he is given director's tickets for a football match on the same day. Meanwhile, Janey is trying to get Kenzo into St Justin's school.
programme.title: My Family

programme.desc: S7 E5 — Susan of Troy Michael succeeds in placing the whole family on 'The Weakest Link', but Anne Robinson is about to raise more difficult questions than expected.
programme.title: My Family

programme.desc: S7 E6 — One of the Boys Roger's mother visits London to meet future daughter-in-law, Abi, and an old drinking mate from Ben's youth has changed much more than he had expected.
programme.title: My Family

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: S4 E7 — Episode 7 Paramedics help a patient found wearing hospital pyjamas in the street, and a man has potentially life-threatening breathing difficulties.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S4 E8 — Episode 8 A woman has the worst nose bleed the ambulance crew have ever seen, and both a mum and her son need treatment.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S4 E9 — Episode 9 Paramedics have to act fast when they attend a patient bleeding heavily from his arm, and a 30-year-old mum has suspected sepsis.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S4 E10 — Episode 10 An ambulance crew rush an elderly patient with suspected sepsis to hospital, and a little girl is reluctant to let the crew examine her cut head.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Highway Hell The crew fight to restart a man's heart after he had a cardiac arrest and crashed the van he was driving. Elsewhere, a young woman is need of help following a series of severe stomach cramps.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S5 E2 — Smart Kid Paramedics desperately try to save a patient whose heart has stopped for more than 15 minutes. Elsewhere, a pregnant woman struggles to breath and a young lad has a deep cut in his hand.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S5 E3 — Panicked Parents Medics treat a man who appears to be having a heart attack and needs to be taken to hospital right away. Meanwhile, crew also help a man who got so confused he came home early from his holiday.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: The Supervet

programme.title: The Supervet

programme.desc: S11 E3 — Betsy, Beau & Rosie A tortoiseshell cat called Betsy needs a bionic implant to clear a cancerous tumour on her leg, and a Tibetan terrier called Beau has complicated surgery to treat hip dysplasia.
programme.title: The Supervet

programme.desc: S11 E4 — Raz, Oscar & Korky A Labrador puppy needs fitted plates and stem cell injections for elbow disease, and Russian Black Terrier has a cancerous growth and is at risk of losing a leg.
programme.title: The Supervet

programme.desc: S11 E5 — Arnold, Benji and Kyte There's a superstar at the Supervet's, and for once it's not the animals that are turning heads. Take That's Mark Owen has arrived with his 18-month-old Doberman, Arnold, currently the largest canine in this dog fan's family.
programme.title: The Supervet
